comparison.objective: Move a steel plate with a switchable magnet and release only after set-down versus tune an axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Magnetic attachment control, load transport, placement, and safe release sequencing versus hex-key manipulation, collar adjustment, and cyclic diagnosis.
comparison.success_condition: Plate must be set down before magnet release; detailed placement thresholds are missing. Candidate requires two locked safe stops.
comparison.reason: Load-control sequencing does not test mechanical adjustment or dynamic response.
